page.overview:
What is Full?

The Full is a ship used by the Baroque Works organization.

The Full is a large purple ship with a yellow crocodile figurehead and a tall white smokestack located forward. The Baroque Works Jolly Roger is painted on the base on the smokestack.

Crocodile supplied the Full with Dance Powder and used it to cause drought and confusion in the Arabasta Kingdom. The ship was captured by the Marines when Smoker discovered Crocodile's plan to incite a civil war in Arabasta.

At Smoker's request, Hina took the Full (along with the defeated Crocodile) into custody.
